game.title: Dragon Realm: The Fire Quest — 2.5D Demo
game.description: A polished 2.5D side-scrolling fantasy action RPG demo: a wizard runs, jumps and battles across three long hand-crafted realms — Enchanted Forest (rivers, waterfalls, bridges), Crystal Caverns (floating platforms, glowing crystals) and Volcanic Peaks (lava, crumbling ledges). Checkpoints, hidden treasure paths, leveling, and a unique multi-phase dragon boss guarding each realm. Earn Fire Power for your Fire Vault by clearing stages.

plan.title: Dragon Realm: The Fire Quest
mechanics: Run and jump across platforms over water and lava
Collect coins, gems and Fire Power
Defeat large dragon boss at end of each level
plan.gameplay_summary: Run and explore short platform segments, avoid hazards and enemies while collecting coins/gems/Fire Power, use dodge rolls and fire spells to survive, then defeat the level dragon boss to progress and unlock upgrades.
plan.concept: A polished 2.5D side-scrolling fantasy platform adventure where a wizard runs, jumps across hazardous platforms over water and lava, casts fire spells, and explores short, hand-crafted levels to collect treasures and defeat dragons. Each of three themed levels ends with a multi-phase dragon boss that tests mobility, spell use, and Fire Power management.

game.request: Dragon Realm: The Fire Quest — a polished 2.5D side-scrolling fantasy platform adventure. A wizard runs, jumps across platforms over water and lava, casts fire spells, fights goblins and bats, collects coins, gems and Fire Power, and defeats a large dragon boss at the end of each of three levels: Enchanted Forest, Crystal Caverns, Volcanic Peaks. Real-time action combat, dodge roll, boss phases, exploration, 2.5D parallax.

spec.title: Dragon Realm: The Fire Quest
spec.description: Three-level side-scrolling fantasy action demo: run, jump, cast fire, defeat dragons.
spec.subject: Game-based learning / Spatial reasoning & resource management
spec.learning_objective: Practice timing, rhythm and pattern recognition (jump timing, boss attack telegraphs), decision-making under pressure (resource—HP/mana/stamina—management) and spatial problem solving while navigating platforms and hazards.
spec.controls: Move: Arrow keys or A/D. Jump: W / Up / Space. Melee (staff bash): J. Fire spell: K. Dodge roll: L or Shift. Pause: P. Restart: R. Mobile: left-side drag joystick + on-screen Jump / Attack / Spell / Dodge buttons. Gamepad supported.
